horoscope: The Moon spends the day in your sign, dear Aries, and your emotions are on your sleeve. Still, Mars in your home and family sector is heading into a challenging aspect to Saturn in your sign, and as the day advances, you can experience a feeling of being unsupported or overly burdened. While this is temporary, it's important to look for ways to make changes in your life to prevent problems like this from growing or festering. You may be digging in your heels, especially if others appear to be pushing or rushing you, or if they are a little too brusque or insensitive for your liking. A slow, patient, and moderate approach is the most successful one today, even if it doesn't come naturally.

With the Moon in your solar twelfth house all day, dear Taurus, it's a good time to learn more about your inner workings and motivations. Watch for defensiveness and sensitivity as the day advances, but do consider that this is a time for the motivation to plan more responsibly or clearly as Mars and Saturn head toward a square aspect. You may be dealing with communication or transportation delays, but while they may seem to set you back, they may very well point you in the right direction. You might now notice details you missed in your haste the first time through. It may be best to finish the things that need a little more attention rather than pushing ahead right now. Aim to tie up loose ends and avoid speaking too soon or too impulsively about a matter for the best results. Your ability to take criticism may be tested today and tomorrow, or you may be wrestling with your inner critic, feeling that what you're doing now isn't your best. Detach yourself and take breaks to help manage potential frustrations better.

You can be drawn to mediating and connecting today, dear Gemini. Turning your attention to the outside world or your loftier goals can be just what you need to gain perspective today. Still, as the day advances, a Mars-Saturn square comes into play, and it can challenge you to face up to reality or to manage a delay or slowdown. Tension and blockages are likely to revolve around your social life or finances, or there can be a conflict between sticking with tried-and-true methods and going out on a limb. You may disagree with someone about core values, or about whether they're valuing you in crucial ways. Consider putting a problem aside for a bit if it just won't budge. You may think of a better way to go about it later.

Your intuition is strong for practical matters, business, money, and career as you begin the day, dear Cancer. Dreams of where you want to head can figure strongly. Still, as the day advances and we head toward a Mars-Saturn square, extra sensitivity and care may be important, as people can be touchy. This might indicate a slowdown if you've been rushing ahead too fast, which is quite likely with energetic Mars currently transiting your sign. This obstacle could take the form of a delay, criticism, reality check, or discouraging moment. Aim to pick yourself back up and strengthen your plans and yourself so you can get back on course, better equipped to weather small storms. You may feel an intense desire to press forward, but obstacles seem to appear as you do. Try not to react to blockages with impatience, as it's not going to support your cause. Slowing down a little can help you in the long run.

Focusing on the bigger picture helps you frame things in a comforting way early today, dear Leo. Your patience with others goes a long way towards enhancing your connections. As the day advances, a Mars-Saturn square comes into play, and it can mean you're dealing with obstacles or slowdowns, or there is a sense that you can't express yourself, your desires, or your frustrations effectively. You could be feeling that you're stuck in the past, unable to move forward. With Mars in your solar twelfth house, you're meant to consider the past more frequently, but it's about putting challenging situations behind you, not focusing on those things you can't control. Later today may not be as free-flowing as you'd like, but it's temporary, and possibly even instructive.

Today's Moon highlights your need to look within or observe rather than push forward with plans, dear Virgo. As the day advances, a Mars-Saturn square comes into play and can have the effect of slowing us down if we've been pushing too hard or too fast in a particular area. For you, this can show up in your relationships. Difficulties with trust and power dynamics that have been festering might now emerge in challenging ways. Bottled-up anger can challenge your health and well-being, while exploding can be destructive as well. Aim for moderation, and you'll be in the best position now. Do your best to respond to challenges with patience and mindfulness. Success with this transit depends on your ability to focus on getting work done rather than worrying too much about how far away a goal might be. All of this can be uncomfortable but revealing, allowing you to see which areas need the most work.

You're inclined to negotiate and compromise today, dear Libra, as the Moon travels through your partnership sector. Still, you can be more sensitive to imbalances in relationships than usual. Aim to identify your feelings and sort them out if they are interfering with clarity. As the day advances, the tone is on the serious side, and you can turn this to your advantage. We approach a Mars-Saturn square that can remind you of limits, rules, or obstacles, most notably through a person or relationship. This means it's time to slow down, reconsider, review, and adjust rather than give up altogether. You may face difficulties with a partner or superior today, or feel misunderstood or blocked when it comes to pursuing your goals or asserting your wishes. Challenges may stem from something you've buried or tucked away. Watch for defensiveness, which won't serve you well. Try not to waste time on anger and, instead, do your best with what you have. Blocks are temporary and may end up being helpful, as redirection can pull your attention to flaws that need correcting before moving forward.

With today's Moon transit, dear Scorpio, you may want to get your daily affairs in order, and the need to be productive and useful is strong. You tend to go out of your way to help out, but you might need to delegate some tasks and make time for yourself. Avoid over-committing. As the day progresses, we head into a Mars-Saturn square, which can bring important releases. You may be dealing with stubbornness in others or blocked plans, but keep in mind that the harder you push or the stronger you come on, the more resistance you're likely to encounter just for now. Try not to waste time and energy on things you can't change, and instead focus on improving what you can manage, one step at a time.

The Moon spends the day in your creative sector, dear Sagittarius, so be sure to make room for playful, personal activities that you truly enjoy. As the day advances, a Mars-Saturn square comes into play, and this transit suggests the need to slow down if you've been pushing a pursuit -- or yourself -- too hard. Intimate matters or issues of money, commitment, trust, and power dynamics can be tricky now, and patience is required. Some off-timing or inhibitions may prevent a smooth flow of affection and direct assertion early today. This may be a better time to slow down or yield.

You are exceptionally resourceful today, dear Capricorn, and strategizing makes the most sense. The Moon spends the day in your family and home sector, signaling the need for some downtime. As the day advances, there can be stop-and-go energy in your relationships as Mars and Saturn head toward a square. Interactions may suffer from poor timing or the perception that others are disapproving and disinterested. There can be a feeling of being blocked, either by others or by circumstances, and this can be frustrating. However, it's also a message from the cosmos to be patient, to wait things out, and to spend a little more time getting things right before pushing ahead with your plans.

With the Moon in your solar third house all day, dear Aquarius, you can enjoy the feeling of being busy but might find it hard to know exactly what you want to do with yourself at times. Distractions can be plenty. People can be holding back their true feelings and more sensitive emotions today, so it could be an uphill battle trying to get the information you crave. As the day advances, if you've been pushing in one direction too quickly, you may encounter blocks to your plans as Mars and Saturn head toward a square. An aggressive or impatient approach to a work project or health program may need some adjustments. Watch for overdoing things simply because you feel capable of doing more than your usual. If you move beyond reasonable boundaries, then aim to do so gradually. Consider that delays can give you the chance to make advantageous refinements and edits so that you can resume your activities better equipped at a later time.

You're in generally good shape for work projects, health programs, and responsibilities today, dear Pisces. As the day advances, a Mars-Saturn square comes into play, and it can seem to apply the brakes to projects and plans that have been moving too fast for their own good. Keep in mind, however, that this is merely a slowdown, not a halt. You've been more confidently pursuing fun and games recently, and today, you might come to a roadblock, and quite possibly a financial limitation. Instead, worries and concerns put a damper on your mood. You may fear change on a basic security level, yet be drawn to taking risks, creating a dilemma. Take your time, avoid pushing in the face of resistance, but do pay attention to your responsibilities and fulfill them to the best of your ability.
